jobs.title: Public Safety Officer (Entry Level
jobs.description: Position: Public Safety Officer (Entry Level) Job TitleSecurity OfficerJob Description Under general supervision, responsible for providing excellent customer service while ensuring the security, safety and well-being of all personnel, visitors and the premises. Immediately responds to emergencies to provide necessary assistance and protects the institution's assets relative to theft, fire, and other safety issues. Enforces the institution's regulations pertaining to parking of vehicles on controlled property.ResponsibilitiesScreens all persons entering the facilities of the University for proper identification. Through observation and patrol, safeguard institutional property, identify security issues and enforce institutional rules and regulations. In emergencies, facilitate the orderly evacuation of the buildings and structures. Secures premises and personnel by patrolling property to include monitoring surveillance equipment, inspecting buildings, equipment, and access points, unlocking/securing buildings, classrooms and non-public areas, and permitting entry. Prevents losses and damage by reporting irregularities and informing violators of policy and procedures. Controls vehicle traffic by directing drivers. Provides security for the campus/special events and conducts foot patrols of buildings and grounds to ensure personal, building, and equipment security. Provides customer service to the public through actions such as Safe Walk escorts and motorist assistance; provides information and direction to students, employees, and visitors. Controls and monitors access by checking permits on parked vehicles and issues visitor permits as needed. Responds to various reports, alarms and/or observed behaviors; assesses situation, notifies Communications Center and supervisor, and determines appropriate action. Completes reports by recording observations, information, occurrences, and surveillance activities as directed. Performs all other duties as assigned.QualificationsProficient with Microsoft Word and Excel. Ability to exhibit great customer service and willingness to interact with the public. Ability to make decisions that deal with uncertainty and require judgment and objectivity. Ability to remain calm and exhibit emotional control, integrity and professionalism. Ability to write complete and concise reports.EDUCATION:High school diploma or GED is required.LICENSE AND CERTIFICATION:Must possess a valid Texas drivers license and be eligible to drive a University owned and/or leased motor vehicle.This position may require the ability to maintain the security and integrity of UT San Antonio and its infrastructure per Texas EO-GA-48.About UsThe University of Texas at San Antonio (UT San Antonio) is a nationally recognized, top-tier public research university that unites the power of higher education, biomedical discovery and healthcare within one visionary institution. As the third-largest research university in Texas and a Carnegie R1-designated institution, UT San Antonio is a model of access and excellence — advancing knowledge, social mobility and public health across South Texas and beyond. UT San Antonio serves approximately 42,000 students in 320 academic programs spanning science, engineering, medicine, health, liberal arts, AI, cybersecurity, business, education and more. With 17,000 faculty and staff, UT San Antonio has been recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Employers for Company Culture. Benefits Overview UT Health San Antonio offers an excellent benefits package for its employees. Employees who work at least 20 hours a week, with an appointment of at least 4.5 months, are eligible for benefits. Medical - UT SELECT Medical insurance is offered free for employees and administered by Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Texas. Family members can be added to the plan through payroll deduction. Employees and their dependents can also receive discounted copays and coinsurance when using UT Health Physicians, a network of 800 premier physicians including more than 100 specialists. Employees receive $50,000 of group term life insurance and $50,000 of basic accidental death and dismemberment insurance for free, with options to…
